$comment: site shape: { name, home, logo: { light, dark? } (media ids), logoHeight, labels: { navigation, submenu, menu, closeMenu, phone?, theme? }, header: { menu: [{ label, href?, children?: [{ label, href }] }], phone: { text, tel }, cta: { label, href }, sticky }, themeToggle }. An item with children and no href draws its label as the span form. state.drawerOpen draws the drawer dialog after the burger (aria-expanded true), with its close button and a panel holding the nav copy (ids site-header__drawer-navigation and site-header__drawer-submenu-<n>, n the item's position counting from 1), the phone link and the call to action. The dialog carries open: it is drawn only when open (SC-019).
summary: The mobile drawer open: burger expanded, the dialog with close button and panel copying the nav (one item with a submenu), phone and call to action.
